purpose: Homepage hero — establish the product's 1:1 personalization pitch with a live-feeling animated visual.

responsive.desktop: hero_visual is an absolutely-positioned em-scaled diagram (see tokens/30-layout/hero-scaling.json) sitting above the h1 in flow.

mobile.change: desktop visual is display:none; a horizontal tag rail + horizontally-scrolling card row (.hero_mobile) replaces it entirely — a structural swap, not a resize.

motion.pattern: fd-h2 (SplitText word reveal) + fd-fade-children on the workflow/audience cards
motion.reducedMotionFallback: render final state, no SplitText/stagger animation
